# Tynkr Tools & Co — Desktop App Suite

> Four privacy-first desktop apps for Windows from Built by Josh Studio LLC, under its Tynkr Tools & Co brand. Everything lives in flat files on your own machine — no cloud, no accounts, no subscriptions. Buy once, own forever. The suite is in development; visitors can get notified at launch.

Tynkr is the desktop software line from Built by Josh Studio (a one-person creative studio in Kansas, incorporated as Built by Josh Studio LLC in 2026; Tynkr Tools & Co is its productivity brand). Each app reads and writes plain files in a folder you choose — open them in any text editor, sync them however you like, or keep them fully offline. Microsoft Store copies make no network requests of their own; copies downloaded from the site make only an optional update check (off unless turned on) and a one-time license activation; airplane mode is a supported configuration. All four apps share the same contract: local-first data you own, one-time purchase, no telemetry, no accounts. The apps are not yet released — the marketing site collects launch notifications (via the Tynkr Tools & Co Substack).

This site (tynkr.builtbyjoshstudio.com) covers the desktop apps only. The broader Built by Josh Studio catalog — Notion OS templates, Excel/Google Sheets workbooks, guided print planners, zodiac art, books, and the cookbook — lives at builtbyjoshstudio.com (index: https://builtbyjoshstudio.com/llms.txt). Fuller file for this site: https://tynkr.builtbyjoshstudio.com/llms-full.txt.

## The apps

- [Tynkr Ledger — Personal Finance OS](https://tynkr.builtbyjoshstudio.com/ledger/): Personal finance on your own disk — transactions, budgets, bills, debt payoff, and net worth. Local-first Windows app; no cloud, no accounts, no subscription.
- [Tynkr Vault — Second Brain OS](https://tynkr.builtbyjoshstudio.com/vault/): Notes, tasks, and weekly reviews as plain Markdown files you own, with fuzzy search in milliseconds. Local-first Windows app; no cloud, no accounts, no subscription.
- [Tynkr Hearth — Homebuyer OS](https://tynkr.builtbyjoshstudio.com/hearth/): The whole home purchase mapped — mortgage math, down-payment planning, cash-to-close, roadmap, and document tracker. Local-first Windows app; no cloud, no accounts.
- [Tynkr Forge — Small Business OS](https://tynkr.builtbyjoshstudio.com/forge/): Invoicing, CRM, purchase orders, contracts, expenses with receipts, and proposals in one local-first Windows app. No cloud, no accounts, no subscription.

## App details and FAQs

### Tynkr Ledger
URL: https://tynkr.builtbyjoshstudio.com/ledger/
What it is: Personal finance on your own disk: transactions, budgets, bills, debt payoff, net worth. Local-first Windows app — no cloud, no accounts, no subscription.
Platform: Windows · category: BusinessApplication · status: in development (not yet released); one-time purchase when it ships.
Q: Does Ledger connect to my bank?
A: No. Ledger never asks for bank credentials and makes no network requests to financial institutions. You import transactions by downloading a CSV from your bank’s website and dropping it into Ledger.
Q: Where is my financial data stored?
A: In plain JSON files in a folder you choose on your own machine — one file per year of transactions, plus config files. You can open, back up, or move them with any tool.
Q: Is there a subscription?
A: No. Ledger is a one-time purchase when it launches. Bug fixes are always free; major version upgrades are a separate purchase. There is no account and no recurring billing.
Q: Does it work offline?
A: Yes, completely. The Microsoft Store version makes no network requests of its own. A copy downloaded from our site makes only an optional update check, off unless you turn it on, and a one-time license activation if it asks for a key. Airplane mode is a supported configuration.
Q: Can I get my data out?
A: It was never locked in. Your ledger is already JSON on your disk, and reports export to CSV. If you stop using Ledger, your files keep working with anything that reads JSON.

### Tynkr Vault
URL: https://tynkr.builtbyjoshstudio.com/vault/
What it is: Notes, tasks, and weekly reviews as plain Markdown files you own. Fuzzy search in milliseconds. Local-first Windows app — no cloud, no accounts, no subscription.
Platform: Windows · category: BusinessApplication · status: in development (not yet released); one-time purchase when it ships.
Q: Are my notes stored in a database?
A: No. Your notes are plain Markdown files in a folder you choose. Vault keeps a local search index for speed, but the files themselves are the source of truth — readable by any editor.
Q: Can I use Vault with an existing folder of Markdown files?
A: Yes. Point Vault at any folder of .md files and it indexes them as-is. Nothing is converted, moved, or renamed.
Q: How do I sync notes between machines?
A: However you like — the vault is just a folder, so any file sync you already trust works. Vault itself never syncs anything and never sends your notes anywhere.
Q: Is there a subscription?
A: No. Vault is a one-time purchase when it launches. Bug fixes are always free; major version upgrades are a separate purchase. No account, no recurring billing.
Q: Does it work offline?
A: Yes, completely. The Microsoft Store version makes no network requests of its own. A copy downloaded from our site makes only an optional update check, off unless you turn it on, and a one-time license activation if it asks for a key.

### Tynkr Hearth
URL: https://tynkr.builtbyjoshstudio.com/hearth/
What it is: The whole home purchase, mapped: mortgage math, down payment planning, cash-to-close, roadmap, document tracker. Local-first Windows app — no cloud, no accounts.
Platform: Windows · category: BusinessApplication · status: in development (not yet released); one-time purchase when it ships.
Q: Is Hearth a mortgage lender or broker?
A: No. Hearth is planning software. It doesn’t sell loans, take referral fees, or send your information to lenders — it has no way to, since nothing leaves your machine.
Q: Where do my documents live?
A: In a plain documents folder on your disk, organized however you like. Hearth tracks status and dates; the files themselves are ordinary files you can open and back up with anything.
Q: Are the mortgage numbers accurate?
A: The math is standard amortization plus the taxes, insurance, PMI, and fee figures you enter. It’s a planning estimate — your lender’s Loan Estimate is the binding document.
Q: Is there a subscription?
A: No. Hearth is a one-time purchase when it launches. Bug fixes are always free; major version upgrades are a separate purchase. No account, no recurring billing.
Q: What happens to my data after I close?
A: It stays yours. The profile JSON and documents folder remain on your disk as a complete record of the purchase — useful at tax time and beyond.

### Tynkr Forge
URL: https://tynkr.builtbyjoshstudio.com/forge/
What it is: Invoicing, CRM, purchase orders, contracts, expenses with receipts, proposals — one local-first Windows app. No cloud, no accounts, no subscription.
Platform: Windows · category: BusinessApplication · status: in development (not yet released); one-time purchase when it ships.
Q: Can Forge send invoices by email?
A: Forge generates the invoice as a PDF you send however you already email — it doesn’t send mail itself or route your client data through any server.
Q: Where does my business data live?
A: In flat JSON files on your disk — one per module — plus a receipts folder of ordinary images. Back it up with whatever you already use.
Q: Can multiple people use it?
A: Forge is built for solo owners and works on one machine at a time. Because the data is flat files, you can share the folder between machines with your own sync — but there’s no multi-user server, by design.
Q: Is there a subscription?
A: No. Forge is a one-time purchase when it launches. Bug fixes are always free; major version upgrades are a separate purchase. No account, no recurring billing.
Q: Does it work offline?
A: Yes, completely. The Microsoft Store version makes no network requests of its own. A copy downloaded from our site makes only an optional update check, off unless you turn it on, and a one-time license activation if it asks for a key.

## Shared contract

- Local-first: your data is plain files in a folder you choose; works fully offline; airplane mode is supported.
- No cloud, no accounts, no subscriptions, no telemetry; the only network call is an optional update check you can turn off.
- One-time purchase per app when released; release builds will be code-signed for Windows and published through public release repositories.
- Publisher: Built by Josh Studio LLC (Tynkr Tools & Co brand); support: josh@builtbyjoshstudio.com.
